segments.name: Biotechnology
segments.description: Non-revenue generating segment that develops cell therapy product candidates for cancer, autoimmune and infectious diseases.
segments.evidence: Biotechnology Segment: This segment is non-revenue generating and incurs expenses by developing its biotechnology product pipeline.

segments.name: Technology
segments.description: Revenue generating segment that acquires technology assets, offering AI-powered marketing software and robotic process automation to business customers.
segments.evidence: Technology Segment: This segment is revenue generating and incurs expenses by acquiring technology assets to support and enhance operational capabilities through advanced technologies.

revenueModel.text: The Technology segment earns sales from its AI-powered marketing software and robotic process automation offerings, while the Biotechnology segment generates no revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: Technology Segment: This segment is revenue generating and incurs expenses by acquiring technology assets to support and enhance operational capabilities through advanced technologies.

changes.text: In 2024 the Company began operating in two segments, Biotechnology and Technology.
changes.evidence: Effective in 2024, the Company began operating in two segments: Biotechnology and Technology.
